title: Release of Gold/Silver/Platinum by Nominated Agencies

business_rules.rule_description:
4.69 Release of Gold/Silver/Platinum by Nominated Agencies
Gold / silver / platinum shall be released to exporter of jewellery by nominated
agencies/RBI authorised banks in multiples of 10 gms or in Ten Tola Bars in
respect of gold.
business_rules.trigger: Release of Gold/Silver/Platinum by Nominated Agencies
business_rules.condition: Not explicitly covered in uploaded documents.
business_rules.validation:
4.69 Release of Gold/Silver/Platinum by Nominated Agencies
Gold / silver / platinum shall be released to exporter of jewellery by nominated
agencies/RBI authorised banks in multiples of 10 gms or in Ten Tola Bars in
respect of gold.
business_rules.exception:
However, silver shall be released to exporters in multiples of 1
Kg only.
